headline: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that Washington has heard Pakistan's concerns over terrorism from Afghanistan and would play a 'productive role' if there is one, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Rubio: zarurat pari to US 'productive role' ada karega

caption:
Amreeka ne Pakistan ki dehshatgardi ki shikayat sun li!
Dawn ke mutabiq US Secretary of State Marco Rubio ne Saturday ko Atlanta mein kaha ke Washington ne Afghanistan se dehshatgardi par Pakistan ke khadshat "sun liye hain" aur agar koi "productive role" ho to US ada karega. Rubio ne kaha: "Hum dehshatgardi ke khilaf hain, chahe woh kahin se bhi ho."
Kya US ko Pak-Afghan masle mein kirdar ada karna chahiye? Comment mein batayein 👇
